plainTranslation:
This person can get right under your skin, sometimes in a good way and sometimes not. Around them, your feelings may come up faster than usual. You may feel drawn in, stirred up, irritated, comforted, or more honest than you expected to be. It is hard to stay detached when someone touches this part of you.

There can be something very immediate about the bond. This person may make you feel wanted in a way that is hard to miss. They may not always say the softest thing, but you can feel that they are present. They respond. They engage. They do not treat your emotions like an inconvenience. If you are used to people going vague or quiet when things get intense, that can feel like a relief.

When this works, it can feel protective. You may feel like they would show up for you if something went wrong, or that they care enough to react when you are hurt. There is a kind of warmth here that is not always gentle, but still feels real.

The problem is that the same closeness can make everything louder. A small comment can feel personal. A mood can turn into an argument. One of you may react first and understand later. If you are not careful, the relationship can start to run on the rush of fighting, making up, and calling the whole thing passion.

Notice the moment your body starts to heat up. That is where you still have a choice. The intensity can be beautiful, but it should not be in charge of the relationship.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
